runlow.name: Runlow: AI Usage Meter
runlow.tagline: Every AI limit you are paying for, on one screen.
runlow.devices: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple Watch · Apple Vision Pro
runlow.keywords: AI usage tracker, Claude usage monitor, ChatGPT Codex limits, Gemini CLI quota, Cursor plan usage, GitHub Copilot requests, OpenRouter credits, token tracker, rate limit monitor, menu bar app
runlow.intro: Every AI subscription has a limit, and not one of them makes it easy to see. Runlow puts Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenRouter side by side as clean colour coded meters that shade from green to red as they fill, so you know where you stand before you hit a wall in the middle of something.

sections.p: Connect any of them, or all of them. Nothing is Claude first and nothing is hidden behind a tier.
ul: Claude: your 5 hour session, weekly caps, per model lanes and credit spend, across multiple accounts
Codex (ChatGPT): 5 hour session and weekly limits, read from the Codex CLI
Gemini CLI: remaining quota per model, picked up automatically as Google adds or retires models
Cursor: plan usage and on demand spend
GitHub Copilot: premium request allowance remaining
OpenRouter: credit balance plus what you have spent today, this week and this month

sections.h: On your Lock Screen, your wrist and your menu bar
sections.p: Pin the meter you care about to the Lock Screen or the Dynamic Island as a Live Activity and see what is left without opening anything. On the Mac the number lives in the menu bar next to the clock. On Apple Watch it is on your wrist. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep it in view everywhere else.

sections.h: Warned before you hit the wall
sections.p: Optional notifications at 80 and 95 per cent, and again the moment a limit resets, so a long session does not end in a surprise. A history graph shows every limit over time and exports as CSV if you want to dig further.

Choose which meter leads. Pick an icon or use your own image. Show a percentage, a countdown, a bar or just the number. Set your own colours or let each bar shade by usage. Hide the meters you do not care about. Light, dark or match the system.

No account to create, no server of ours, no analytics, no tracking. Runlow reads your usage on your own machine and keeps it there. Your credentials live in the Keychain and sync only through your own iCloud if you choose.

reprompt.name: Reprompt: Teleprompter
reprompt.tagline: A teleprompter that does not lose your take.
reprompt.devices: iPhone · iPad · Mac · Apple TV · Apple Watch
reprompt.keywords: teleprompter app, Mac teleprompter, script scrolling, video recording, YouTube creator tools, presentation prompter, webcam teleprompter, remote control prompter
reprompt.intro: Reprompt is a teleprompter for people who film themselves. On the Mac it is a real Mac app with a real menu bar, not an iPad app dropped into a window. It scrolls your script at your reading pace, records while it scrolls, and it does not lose your take.

sections.p: Space bar rolls and pauses. Arrow keys change speed. Command N starts a new script, Command I imports one, Escape closes the prompter. Resize the window and the text reflows. It is a desk prompter built for a webcam shoot, not a phone app in a bigger box.

Your video is committed to disk in short fragments while you record, rather than written in one go at the end. If the app is interrupted or the machine goes to sleep, the take is still there when you come back, and Reprompt tells you it survived.

One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV and Apple Watch. No account, no sign up, no trial that quietly becomes a monthly bill, and no feature you already paid for moving behind a new tier later.
ul: No watermark on your video, not on the first take and not ever
Mirroring for glass and beam splitter rigs
Every future update included

recast.name: Recast: File Converter
recast.tagline: Convert almost anything, without uploading a single byte.
recast.keywords: file converter iPhone, video converter, photo converter, HEIC to JPEG, PDF to image, GIF to MP4, offline converter, compress video to size, no upload converter
recast.intro: Pick a photo, video, PDF, audio file, GIF or Live Photo, choose what you want out of it, and Recast does the rest. Every conversion happens on your device. There is no account, no upload, and no waiting on someone else's server.

sections.p: Most converters give you a quality slider and leave you guessing. Recast lets you say what the file needs to weigh, then works backwards to get there. Under 10 MB for email, under 25 MB, or a number you pick yourself.

sections.h: Honest when it cannot get there
sections.p: Sometimes a target simply cannot be reached at full resolution. Recast tells you plainly instead of quietly missing, and offers to shrink the video itself to get closer.

ul: Photos: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, and into PDF
PDFs: to JPEG or PNG page by page, or compressed as PDF
Video: MP4, MOV and more, with a size target
Audio and GIFs, including Live Photos

sections.p: Everything runs on the device, so it works on a plane and it works with files you would rather not hand to a website. No account, no tracking, no subscription.

sections.h: Free, with an optional Pro unlock
sections.p: Recast itself is free. Recast Pro removes the adverts and adds unlimited files, batch conversion and PDF merge, as a one time purchase, not a subscription.

refast.name: Refast: 16:8 Fasting Timer
refast.tagline: How long is left. That is the whole idea.
refast.keywords: intermittent fasting timer, 16:8 fasting, fasting tracker, eating window, fasting streak, no subscription fasting app
refast.intro: A fasting timer that shows you the one thing you actually want to know, and does not try to be a food diary, a coach or a subscription while it is at it.

sections.p: Start your fast and Refast counts down your eating window on a single clear ring. Glance at it and you know. That is the app.
Every fast is recorded so you can see your streak and your trend over weeks rather than guessing. Trends are laid out to be read at a glance on the Mac as well as the phone.

The core timer is free. Refast Plus adds your full history, trends, custom plans and iCloud sync, as a one time unlock, not a subscription. No account, no daily nudge to buy something, and your data stays on your device either way.

gainscout.name: GainScout: BNG Land Finder
gainscout.tagline: Check any field in England for Biodiversity Net Gain potential, in one tap.
gainscout.closer: Free to download and free to check land. No account, no tracking. Reports and GainScout Pro are optional.
gainscout.keywords: biodiversity net gain, BNG, land check England, habitat bank, off site units, land agent, planning consultant, farmland, SSSI, agricultural land classification, flood risk, green belt
gainscout.intro: GainScout is the fastest way to take a first look at whether a piece of land in England could be a candidate for Biodiversity Net Gain, the planning rule that has developers paying landowners to make land better for nature.

sections.p: Point the map at a field and press one button. GainScout reads that exact spot against official public government datasets and gives you a plain English answer in seconds, with every finding's source and the date it was checked. Nothing is estimated and nothing is invented.

ul: Statutory designations: SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, national and local nature reserves
Ancient woodland and priority habitats
Agricultural land grade, with the best and most versatile farmland flagged
Flood risk zones
Green Belt, National Landscapes and conservation areas
The Local Nature Recovery Strategy for the area
Registered biodiversity gain sites nearby, the off site market you would price against
Save sites and track them from watching to in talks
Add a walkover checklist, notes and timestamped evidence photos
Create a dated report with findings, sources, your photos and an OS grid reference, ready to hand to an agent, ecologist or buyer, and export it as a PDF
Area Scan to rank the most promising spots across an area
Draw your parcel to trace a boundary for instant acreage and a spot by spot check
Sites, reports and photos synced through your own iCloud

sections.h: Free to check, pay for what you need
sections.p: Every check and every walkover feature is free to use. Buy a report when you need one, one credit or a pack of ten, or subscribe to GainScout Pro for unlimited land checks and reports plus every other Pro tool, billed monthly, quarterly or yearly, cancel any time.

gridsong.name: Gridsong: Music Maker
gridsong.tagline: Tap a grid. Nothing you play can sound wrong.
gridsong.keywords: music maker app, beat maker, loop sequencer, make music no skill, pentatonic grid, lofi, ambient, drum machine, songwriting app
gridsong.intro: Gridsong turns a glowing grid into an instrument anyone can play. Tap a square and it plays a note. Tap a few more and you have a melody, because the whole grid is locked to a musical scale, so nothing you tap can sound wrong.

sections.h: No lessons, no theory, no wrong notes
sections.p: Drag across the grid to paint a run of notes, press play, and it loops. Start from a template or a blank grid.

sections.h: What you get to play with
ul: Ten built in instruments including Bell, Pluck, Glass, Voice and Bass
Drums, with tempo you control
Record your own sounds and play them across the grid
Loop, duplicate and layer patterns into a full song
Record a video of your loop and share it anywhere
Patterns synced across iPhone and Mac with iCloud
